scope.summary: The supplied contracts resolve the earlier unknowns. Generated format strings reach both changed numeric handlers; the four remaining changes affect only tests. The target's build, input handling, lifetime, and control flow are supported by the supplied code. No update obligation is established.

Integer formatting dispatches the parsed type to the changed handler.

The argument formatter dispatches floating-point values to the writing path.

The called memory-buffer format_to overload remains available.

input.reason: The entry consumes a selector, then requires more than Nfixed bytes before copying an argument of at most Nfixed bytes. Remaining bytes form a sized, separately allocated format view.

Selects the separately allocated format buffer.

lifecycle.reason: The format buffer, argument, and output buffer remain alive through each call. The time branch checks localtime before use, and exceptions unwind local objects within the entry's catch.

The memory buffer owns and releases any allocated storage.

control_flow.reason: The selected format_to overload delegates to vformat_to, which parses replacement fields, records the type character, and visits the selected numeric argument. Integer and floating-point visitors reach their respective changed handlers.

evidence.dependency_reason: The buffer overload delegates into the runtime parser.
A replacement field parses specs and visits its argument.
The integer visitor calls the changed integer handler.
The floating-point visitor calls write, which parses the changed float type.
